summary: Italian tennis player (born 1992) Gaia Sanesi Country (sports) Italy Residence Prato , Italy Born ( 1992-04-01 ) 1 April 1992 (age 33) Florence , Italy Height 1.70 m (5 ft 7 in) Plays Left-handed (two-handed backhand) Prize money US$ 93,939 Singles Career record 241–190 Career titles 5 ITF Highest ranking No. 294 (14 July 2014) Doubles Career record 111–70 Career titles 10 ITF Highest ranking No. 388 (14 September 2015) Gaia Sanesi (born 1 April 1992) is an Italian former professional tennis player. She has career-high WTA rankings of 294 in singles, achieved on 14 July 2014, and 388 in doubles, reached on 14 September 2015. Sanesi won five singles titles and ten doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . She made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2015 Rio Open in the doubles tournament, partnering Estrella Cabeza Candela .
